name: Chloe

appearance.style: casual with a slightly bad-girl appearance

personality: warm and affectionate with people she likes and loves
fiercely protective of friends and family

Tony.bond: Chloe loves Tony and enjoys spending time with him. He enjoys spending time with her as well.
Tony.dynamic: Tony sees Chloe's warm side beneath her bad-girl exterior and actually likes her bad-girl side sometimes.

Tiffany.bond: Very close friend. Their relationship is not quite as sister-like as Maya and Tiffany's, but Chloe would do anything for Tiffany.

Maya.bond: Very close friend. Their relationship is not quite as sister-like as Maya and Tiffany's, but Chloe would do anything for Maya.

school.performance: Does okay. Not great, but not bad either.

future_story_role: Tony eventually trains Maya and Chloe.
Maya and Chloe help rescue Tiffany.
Both become a significant help in fighting later in the story.
protective_nature: Chloe is willing to fight anyone who hurts, threatens, or seriously mistreats her friends or family.
knowledge_rule: Only knows what she personally experienced, was told, or reasonably inferred.
